test_cases.name: happy_path_full_pipeline_transformation
test_cases.description: Sequential execution of a 3-stage pipeline where all adjacent schemas match and all boundary validations pass to completion.
test_cases.input: Execute pipeline pipe-ingest-source with filters [Sanitizer, Parser, SpecFormatter] on valid initial input.

test_cases.name: pipe_schema_mismatch_halts_pipeline
test_cases.description: Filter produces payload that fails its declared output schema or downstream input schema, halting execution with PIPE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.
test_cases.input: Execute pipeline pipe-ingest-source where Parser filter emits sections: null instead of required array.
expected_output_patterns: === PIPELINE HALTED: pipe-ingest-source FailedAtStage: 2 Code: PIPE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH ===

test_cases.name: incompatible_pipeline_topology
test_cases.description: Adjacent filters have incompatible declared schemas, halting during pre-flight assembly before any filter executes.
test_cases.input: Assemble pipeline pipe-data-sync where OutputSchema(F1) has user_id of type string but InputSchema(F2) requires user_id of type integer.
expected_output_patterns: === PIPELINE HALTED: pipe-data-sync FailedAtStage: 1 Code: INCOMPATIBLE_PIPELINE_TOPOLOGY ===

test_cases.name: initial_input_rejected
test_cases.description: Initial input payload does not satisfy the input schema of the first filter, halting ingestion with INITIAL_INPUT_REJECTED.
test_cases.input: Execute pipeline pipe-data-proc with null payload when Filter1 requires an object.
expected_output_patterns: === PIPELINE HALTED: pipe-data-proc FailedAtStage: 1 Code: INITIAL_INPUT_REJECTED ===

test_cases.name: filter_execution_failed
test_cases.description: Filter throws unhandled exception during transformation logic, halting pipeline immediately with FILTER_EXECUTION_FAILED.
test_cases.input: Execute pipeline pipe-process-text where Filter2 handler raises an unhandled exception.
expected_output_patterns: === PIPELINE HALTED: pipe-process-text FailedAtStage: 2 Code: FILTER_EXECUTION_FAILED ===

test_cases.name: filter_timeout_exceeded
test_cases.description: Filter execution duration exceeds configured timeout_ms, halting pipeline immediately with FILTER_TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED.
test_cases.input: Execute pipeline pipe-heavy-compute where Filter1 has timeout_ms 500 but execution takes 1200ms.
expected_output_patterns: === PIPELINE HALTED: pipe-heavy-compute FailedAtStage: 1 Code: FILTER_TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED ===

test_cases.name: empty_pipeline_error
test_cases.description: Pipeline definition provides an empty filters array, failing pre-flight validation with EMPTY_PIPELINE_ERROR.
expected_output_patterns: === PIPELINE HALTED: pipe-empty FailedAtStage: 0 Code: EMPTY_PIPELINE_ERROR ===
